newsitem.title: USA: Dresser unit to fund NUMAR technology.
newsitem.headline: Dresser unit to fund NUMAR technology.

text.p: Dresser Industries Inc said Thursday its Sperry-Sun Drilling Service unit will fund development of a version of NUMAR Corp's MRIL tool for use as a FEWD -- for formation evaluation while drilling -- tool.

Sperry-Sun has agreed to begin funding the development beginning in the fourth quarter, Dresser said. The objective is to develop a version of NUMAR's MRIL tool, used in open-hole MRI -- for magnetic resonance imaging -- logging, for use attached to the drill string as an FEWD tool. This project will be managed by NUMAR, with significant participation by Sperry-Sun.
If the development project is successful, the companies have agreed to jointly market the new tool with distribution of the FEWD service by Sperry-Sun and manufacturing by NUMAR.

Assuming the successful completion of the project, Dresser said, Sperry-Sun Drilling Services is committed to purchase, over a three-year period, a minimum of 20 MRIL-based FEWD tool kits valued at aabout $15 million.

FEWD is a process of determining the quantity of oil, gas, and water as a well is being drilled, as opposed to open-hole logging which is a method of gaining similar information immediately after drilling is halted, and the drill string is removed.

The major advantages of FEWD as compared with open-hole logging are rig time savings and improvement in data quality because the measurement is made before the formation fluids are affected by drilling fluid invasion. FEWD is also used for geosteering to optimized wellbore contact with a reservoir. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
